title: Carbon-Aware Routing for Function Calling in Edge-Cloud LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.13559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) with function-calling capabilities are becoming critical for modern agentic AI systems. Nevertheless, current deployments typically route inferences to powerful cloud-based models, incurring significant energy use and carbon emissions. We address this sustainability challenge with a carbon-aware routing framework that distributes function-calling queries across a three-tier edge-cloud architecture, combining edge and cloud LLMs on heterogeneous hardware. At its core, a lightweight k-NN predictor operating in a unified semantic-lexical embedding space estimates query-specific accuracy, delay, and power consumption on each edge tier. These predictions are then combined with real-time grid carbon intensity to route every query to the lowest-emission tier capable of executing it successfully. translated_title: 边缘-云端大语言模型系统中面向函数调用的碳感知路由
translated_abstract: 具备函数调用能力的大语言模型正成为现代智能体AI系统的关键组成部分。然而，当前的部署方式通常将推理请求路由到强大的云端模型，这会带来巨大的能源消耗和碳排放。我们通过一个碳感知路由框架来应对这一可持续性挑战，该框架将函数调用查询分布在三层边缘-云端架构中，结合了异构硬件上的边缘和云端大语言模型。框架的核心是一个运行在统一语义-词汇嵌入空间中的轻量级k-NN预测器，用于估算每个边缘层级上针对特定查询的准确率、延迟和功耗。这些预测随后与实时电网碳强度相结合，将每个查询路由到能够成功执行该查询的最低排放层级。在最先进的函数调用基准测试和大语言模型家族上的评估表明，我们的框架在达到云端级别准确率的同时…
tldr: 该论文提出了一种碳感知路由框架，利用统一嵌入空间中的轻量级k-NN预测器结合实时电网碳强度，将函数调用查询智能分配到三层边缘-云端架构中的最优层级，在保持云端级别准确率的同时显著降低碳排放。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a carbon-aware routing framework that combines a lightweight k-NN predictor in a unified embedding space with real-time grid carbon intensity to intelligently route function-calling queries to the optimal tier in a three-tier edge-cloud architecture, matching cloud-level accuracy while significantly reducing carbon emissions.
